comparison_design.ablation_d: identity vs coarse uniform vs matching-aware task-aware quantization with the same selection engine and exact original evaluation charged to runtime
comparison_design.approx_c: deterministic exhaustive rounded-model optimizer on tiny cases; bounded greedy/branch enumeration on stress cases; rounded global lower bound is used only when the search exhausts the rounded feasible space
comparison_design.fairness: same frozen original instance, budget, seed, wall-clock cap, and environment metadata for each method/setup; no post-hoc corpus or threshold tuning
comparison_design.reference_a: independent exact Fraction original-model exhaustive outer subsets plus labeled ordinary/maximal matching enumeration on the small tier
comparison_design.reference_b: NOT EXECUTED unless an unchanged reproducible external solver adapter can be used without changing ess-advisor or adding production code; no speed comparison if unavailable
required_metrics: original-model feasible selection and exact loss
certified original lower bound and upper bound when valid
actual perturbation error versus predicted eta

exploratory_stress_tier.purpose: bounded stress only; exact original truth is expected to be unavailable or timeout for some rows
exploratory_stress_tier.truth_policy: record TRUTH_UNAVAILABLE or TIMEOUT explicitly; never infer a global optimum from a heuristic or inherited tiny truth

small_tier.random_generator: Python random.Random(seed); integer draws and explicit candidate lists only

random_rules.alpha: signed rationals including negative baselines, zero, strong cancellation, and near-zero optimum
random_rules.budget: selected from {0,1/2,1,2,3,4,6,8} and clipped to the instance cost range
random_rules.coefficients: signed rationals from {-3,-2,-1,-1/3,0,1/4,1/2,1,2,3}; deterministic cancellation fixtures may use alpha and coefficients with exact denominators 2,3,4
random_rules.edge_shape: stratum-specific path/star/disjoint/cycle/mixed templates; labels e0..e(n-1), duplicate endpoint labels permitted
random_rules.maintenance: nonnegative rationals from {0,1/2,1,2}; zero-cost candidates are mandatory
random_rules.task_resource_sharing: each task independently samples eligible labeled resources with probability 0.70, then retains at least one edge unless the explicit empty-task case is used

edge_case_requirements: rounded-to-zero selected edge retained in graph
multiple tasks sharing resources but separate adversaries
budget zero and fully slack budget
failure and timeout are first-class outcomes

environment_policy.dependencies: stdlib-first; no non-stdlib dependency is required for correctness or the pilot
environment_policy.timing_interpretation: diagnostic and environment-dependent; timing bytes need not hash identically across reruns

evidence_policy.hashes: SHA256SUMS over committed evidence and manifests
evidence_policy.negative_results: preserve counterexamples, vacuous bounds, unavailable truth, failures, and timeouts
evidence_policy.raw_observations: one deterministic JSON record per instance/setup/run
evidence_policy.rerun_policy: verify committed evidence before re-execution; rerun only into a new scratch directory; never overwrite preserved evidence

model.admissibility: task-wise maximal matchings of the selected labeled task graph
model.adversaries: independent task-wise maxima; no shared adversarial policy is introduced
model.arithmetic: fractions.Fraction for every correctness value; float timing is diagnostic only
model.maintenance: nonnegative additive proxy sum_e maintenance[e] <= budget; zero-cost resources allowed
model.matching_semantics: maximal, not maximum-cardinality; parallel labeled edges remain distinct; rounded-zero edges remain eligible
model.objective: sum_i w_i max_{P in MaximalMatchings(H_i[M])} abs(alpha_i + sum_{e in P} b[e,i])
model.outer_selection: one globally shared unordered labeled resource set M

protocol_change_policy: preserve v1; any changed corpus, quantization, threshold, or stopping rule must be a clearly versioned v2 manifest and a separate protocol commit

quality_targets.decision_rule: GO only if no certificate violations, a predeclared nontrivial tau is reached with an original-model certified bound, and an equal-clock same-objective reference shows observed computational benefit; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE or NO-GO as specified by the evidence

quantization_setups.rounding: nearest multiple of delta_i; exact Fraction arithmetic; half-way ties toward zero

quantization_setups.nu_definition: ordinary maximum matching cardinality of the full eligible task graph, independently cross-checked by exhaustive ordinary matchings
quantization_setups.rounding: nearest multiple of task-specific delta_i; exact Fraction arithmetic; half-way ties toward zero

quantization_setups.nu_definition: ordinary maximum matching cardinality of the full eligible task graph, independently cross-checked by exhaustive ordinary matchings
quantization_setups.rounding: nearest multiple of task-specific delta_i; exact Fraction arithmetic; half-way ties toward zero

scope: Bounded falsification-first pilot for certified approximate task-wise PESS solutions; no production solver, PostgreSQL measurement, or paper claim.
